purpose: Teach: なぁー/夕べ/損なう/曲がり/崩さ/行き方/引き続い/ごくごく

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、「なぁー、いい天気だな」ってお父さんが仰ったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said something earlier — "Isn't it nice weather?"
lines.style: Warm recollection, as though sharing a small moment she noticed. Gentle pace. A slight smile in the voice — not correcting, just remembering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、夕べ、ぼくお祖父ちゃんの夢を見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I had a dream about Grandpa last night.
lines.style: Soft, thoughtful opening. A child's certainty mixed with gentle wonder. Pause before 'Grandpa' — the dream still feels present. Quiet, not seeking reaction.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達の気持ちを損なう発言はしないでね
lines.en: Sho, let's make sure we don't say things that hurt our friends' feelings, okay?
lines.style: Kind but clear. Mother's gentle firmness — not scolding, redirecting. Steady eye contact in the voice. A pause before the request, letting it land.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お絵描きで線の曲がりを綺麗に描いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I drew really clean curves in my picture today.
lines.style: Bright with quiet pride. Not loud — a child showing something he worked hard on. Slight lift on 'clean curves' — the accomplishment matters to him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんは姿勢を崩さない方ね
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather — he doesn't let his posture slip.
lines.style: Observational, almost to herself. Warm admiration wrapped in reflection. Slow, as if Yumiko is noticing this quality in real time, recognizing it in Sho.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんに行き方を教えてもらったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa taught me how to walk the right way.
lines.style: Earnest and serious in a child's way. Each word matters — he is reporting something important he's learned. Steady, not rushed. Pride in the knowledge itself.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、雨が引き続いて困るわね
lines.en: Sho, this rain just keeps going — it's becoming quite inconvenient.
lines.style: Practical observation with a thread of mild frustration. Not complaint, but acknowledgment. Thinking aloud, comfortable in the moment with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんと、ごくごく水を飲んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa and I drank water together — big gulps.
lines.style: Eager, almost bubbling with the memory. A child delighted by a simple, ordinary moment made special because it was with Grandpa. Warmth and closeness in the pace.
